import pandas as pd

# File paths for source tables
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_11/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_11/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_11/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_11/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_11/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_11/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_11/training_6.csv",
]

# Read all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Union all source tables by concatenation
Target6_11 = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the schema and types match the target schema
Target6_11 = Target6_11.astype({'air_store_id': 'string', 'dow': 'int64'})

# Write the final target table to the specified path
Target6_11.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_11/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
